description: Figure: hominoid distribution of the LRP5L duplicate, concerted-evolution test, site-pattern counts, and CpG-masked dN/dS
code:
import json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
igc=json.load(open("igc_test.json")); cpg=json.load(open("dnds_cpg_masked.json"))
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14.5,9.5))

# A: species distribution
axA=fig.add_subplot(2,2,1)
sp=[("Homo sapiens (hg38)","ORF open",0),("Pan troglodytes (T2T)","ORF open",0),
    ("Pan paniscus (T2T)","ORF open",0),("Gorilla gorilla (T2T + gorGor6)","frameshift, stops",1),
    ("Pongo abelii (T2T)","locus absent",2),("Pongo pygmaeus (T2T)","locus absent",2),
    ("Symphalangus syndactylus","ORF open",0),("Nomascus leucogenys","present, exon 1 in gap",3),
    ("Macaca mulatta (rheMac10)","locus absent",2)]
cols={0:"#2b7a3d",1:"#c23b22",2:"#777777",3:"#1f6fb4"}
for i,(n,s,c) in enumerate(sp[::-1]):
    axA.barh(i,1,color=cols[c],alpha=.85)
    axA.text(1.03,i,s,va="center",fontsize=9)
axA.set_yticks(range(len(sp))); axA.set_yticklabels([x[0] for x in sp[::-1]],fontsize=9)
axA.set_xlim(0,2.6); axA.set_xticks([])
axA.set_title("A  LRP5L duplicate across primates (BLAT of human and siamang ORF)",fontsize=10,loc="left")
for s in ["top","right","bottom"]: axA.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# B: concerted evolution test
axB=fig.add_subplot(2,2,2)
pw=igc["pairwise"]; order=["HL-SL","HP-SP","HL-HP","SL-SP","HL-SP","SL-HP"]
lab=["LRP5L\nhum-sia","LRP5\nhum-sia","LRP5L-LRP5\nboth human","LRP5L-LRP5\nboth siamang",
     "LRP5L hum\nLRP5 sia","LRP5L sia\nLRP5 hum"]
vals=[pw[o][3] for o in order]
cc=["#1f6fb4","#1f6fb4","#c23b22","#c23b22","#e8a33d","#e8a33d"]
axB.bar(range(6),vals,color=cc)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): axB.text(i,v+0.002,f"{v:.3f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
axB.set_xticks(range(6)); axB.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=8)
axB.set_ylabel("Jukes-Cantor distance (759 nt)")
axB.set_title("B  Within-species paralog distance is not reduced:\nno concerted evolution",fontsize=10,loc="left")
axB.axhline(np.mean(vals[2:]),ls="--",c="k",lw=.8)

# C: site patterns
axC=fig.add_subplot(2,2,3)
c=igc["counts"]
axC.bar([0,1,2],[c["DD|PP"],c["HH|SS"],c["other"]],color=["#1f6fb4","#c23b22","#bbbbbb"])
for i,v in enumerate([c["DD|PP"],c["HH|SS"],c["other"]]): axC.text(i,v+0.6,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=9)
axC.set_xticks([0,1,2])
axC.set_xticklabels(["paralog-clustered\n(duplicates agree,\nparents agree)",
                     "species-clustered\n(gene-conversion\nsignature)","other / singleton"],fontsize=8)
axC.set_ylabel("variable sites")
axC.set_title("C  Site patterns in the 4-sequence alignment\n37 vs 1, binomial p = %.1e"%igc["binom_p"],fontsize=10,loc="left")

# D: omega all vs CpG-masked
axD=fig.add_subplot(2,2,4)
names=["human-siamang\nLRP5L","human-chimp\nLRP5L","human-bonobo\nLRP5L","human-siamang\nLRP5 parent"]
keys=["human-siamang LRP5L","human-chimp LRP5L","human-bonobo LRP5L","human-siamang LRP5 parent"]
a=[max(cpg[k]["all_sites"].get("omega",0),0) for k in keys]
b=[max(cpg[k]["CpG_masked"].get("omega",0),0) for k in keys]
pa=[cpg[k]["all_sites"].get("p") for k in keys]; pb=[cpg[k]["CpG_masked"].get("p") for k in keys]
x=np.arange(4); w=.36
axD.bar(x-w/2,a,w,label="all sites",color="#4c72b0")
axD.bar(x+w/2,b,w,label="CpG dinucleotides masked",color="#dd8452")
for i in range(4):
    axD.text(x[i]-w/2,a[i]+.02,f"{a[i]:.2f}\np={pa[i]:.3g}",ha="center",fontsize=7)
    axD.text(x[i]+w/2,b[i]+.02,f"{b[i]:.2f}\np={pb[i]:.3g}",ha="center",fontsize=7)
axD.axhline(1,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); axD.text(3.45,1.02,"neutral",fontsize=8,ha="right")
axD.axhspan(0,0.2,color="#9ecf9e",alpha=.35)
axD.text(-0.45,0.21,"range for conserved coding genes",fontsize=7.5,color="#2b7a3d")
axD.set_xticks(x); axD.set_xticklabels(names,fontsize=8); axD.set_ylim(0,1.25)
axD.set_ylabel("dN/dS (Nei-Gojobori, JC corrected)"); axD.legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper right")
axD.set_title("D  The sub-neutral omega of LRP5L is a CpG artefact;\nthe LRP5 parent has zero nonsynonymous change",fontsize=10,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
